scope: Workflows 51-100, isolated SQLite test databases and Chrome against loopback disposable QA server on port 5297. The existing app company was only inspected, not used for test writes.
fixes: Recover interrupted Inventory POS payment from a durable unique sale key; reject changed-payload reuse; preserve key across browser reload and unlock controls after network failures.
Enforce normal invoice discount range 0-100 and reject inactive products in new invoices/POS.
Use original sale price/tax and cost for linked returns; enforce cumulative quantity and customer checks; update weighted-average valuation at original return cost.
Restore unsaved Suite sales-order forms for the same user/company/branch and clear recovery after a successful save.
Display an explicit unavailable/access message for inaccessible commercial records instead of an empty Record 1.
limitations: Full browser execution of all 50 workflows was not completed. Workflow status is limited to the recorded execution scope.
SQLite checks do not certify PostgreSQL concurrency, locking or the new PostgreSQL migration; migration included but not applied to a live database.
Suite sales-order detail currently lacks line-edit and approval controls; these operations remain UI gaps.
No external email, accounting outage or real payment-provider charge was triggered.
Inventory/POS Flask fixes and Suite React form fixes affect distinct application surfaces; passing one does not certify the other.
